verdict.rationale: AutoGen is code-first: AutoGen Studio's visual team builder is backed by declarative JSON specs, and teams built in the UI can be exported and run in Python, served as endpoints, or run in Docker. The Python AgentChat API covers the same building blocks (agents, teams, memory, component serialization, programmatic `run`). Missing for 10: an explicit documented UI/API parity statement, evidence that Studio-only features (gallery import, pause/stop run control) are programmatically accessible, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
